whenToUse: Location trails on docs, store and admin pages that link back up to each parent level
Workspace, team and file paths whose levels carry avatars, icons, count badges or button styling
Deep hierarchies whose middle levels collapse into an ellipsis or a dropdown menu

whenNotToUse.when: A whole top header that pairs the trail with tabs, search, switchers and account menus
A full product layout of side navigation, header and content around the trail
A divider line between page sections or groups of toolbar controls

agentNotes: `BreadcrumbLink` takes a router link through `render` on the base twin and `asChild` on the radix twin
Every level is hard coded and each `href` is a hash placeholder; build the `BreadcrumbItem` list from your route tree
